summary: Separate strict plain-text and Gmail HTML email signatures into reviewable non-current evidence so company names and workflow-like signature text cannot route work or enter model extraction.
decision_refs: Active user goal to improve efficiency, accuracy and adaptability for RFI, Submittal and Email content
Synthetic regression showing signature text entered current-body model input and produced a false material candidate
Existing deterministic path that retains non-current email evidence while completing it locally before extraction
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only an exact plain-text -- delimiter with its trailing space, optionally behind quote prefixes, and the exact Gmail gmail_signature class are recognized; arbitrary closings, titles or visual styles are not guessed as signatures.
Unknown client signatures remain current evidence and require reviewer attention.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or paid provider was used.
